idea-plugin.name: Aero Agent Roles
idea-plugin.description:
Aero Agent Roles — the role layer for aerospace engineering agents.

A skill does one task correctly. A role binds the right verified skills from Aero Agent Skills into a certification workflow, in order, with evidence gates and a human sign-off line. 22+ roles across aerodynamics, avionics, flight mechanics, GNC/autonomy, propulsion, structures, space systems, and more.

  • Role catalog browser (search any role in the IDE)
  • One-click MCP registration for JetBrains AI Assistant / Junie
  • Aero Agent Roles external-registry link (browse roles in the AI Assistant)

Apache-2.0 · github.com/ashfordeOU/aero-agent-roles
